review.notes: BT-02 Post-Fix Human Review by Mohammed walid. Analysis AN-20261018-160835-f96a examined four recorded Windows Security events. Events E001 and E003 confirm successful Service Logons (Event ID 4624, Logon Type 5) associated with the SYSTEM account. Events E002 and E004 document special privileges assigned to these logon sessions (Event ID 4672), including SeDebugPrivilege. Compared with the initial analysis, Mistral correctly identified the service logon type and preserved the evidence timeline. However, the model continued to describe the privilege assignments as unusual without establishing an operational baseline. Automated Validation generated one medium-severity finding_without_evidence_ref flag. The analyst classified F001 as Needs Follow-up because the finding lacks an evidence reference and its unusual-activity assessment is not independently established. No malicious privilege usage or unauthorized escalation was confirmed. Human Review Status: Corrected.
